title: The structure of forms/code-rules.tsv of P/01
description: Columns and order; kind and stage are keys of Platform/common/forms.keys.sql (code_kind, stage). Instance: {"columns": the header cells, "rows": the data rows as arrays of raw cells}; comment lines (#) are not rows. Rules that this schema does not express stay with the existing checks (OBSH.39.1 raw-map).
